category_summary: **Hermes Agent** platform momentum is broad this cycle. First-party: **[Claude Pro/Max](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49790991)** subscription support via the **claude-subscription-directsdk** plugin removes the API-key barrier for consumer users, and **[Hermes Kanban](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49604068)** adds native multi-agent profile coordination — together the two highest-impact changes for day-to-day users. Ecosystem growth: **[Verso](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49628094)** (free open-source orchestrator for knowledge work), the **[ClusterMob](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-50197497)** community profile registry, the **[Paper Harness](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-50278175)** native **SwiftUI** iPhone client, and YC S26-backed **[Almanac](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49511007)** building a company-context agent directly on Hermes. Production hardening dominates the ops theme: no official **[Helm](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49977400)** chart and a root-at-init container image remain real adoption gaps, while community guides cover [containerization](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-50131496), the **[grafana-agento11y-hermes](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49318128)** observability stack, and low-power hosts like the **[Arduino UNO Q](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49368474)** (4GB RAM). The **[Refine Cycle](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49606988)** self-improvement plugin signals a capability direction worth tracking. Watch items for operators: ~[23,000 open PRs](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49424643) straining maintainer review capacity, a **[GLM 5.3 Flash](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49916751)**-powered agent entering a runaway thinking loop on headless Debian, and [adversarial reversal](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49231797) probing of the agent. Pure research: **[EPSBench](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-2610.38293)** (149 firm-quarters, 86 US companies) benchmarks LLM agents on quarterly earnings forecasting; the **[Claude Code](/?date=2026-11-02&category=research#item-hn-49305190)** earnings-embeddings plugin is adjacent but not Hermes-native.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.content: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted ear
